## Education

**Ph.D., Public Policy** — Georgia Institute of Technology, Jimmy and Rosalynn Carter
School of Public Policy *(in progress)*

**M.S., Computer Science** — Georgia Institute of Technology, specialization in Machine
Learning *(in progress)*

**M.S., Statistics** — Georgia Institute of Technology *(in progress)*

## Research Interests

Innovation policy · patent law and economics · artificial intelligence · causal inference ·
computational social science

## Methods

Difference-in-differences and modern robustness methods (event studies, HonestDiD
sensitivity analysis, entropy balancing) · large-scale text analysis of patent claims ·
full-population patent data pipelines (PatentsView, EPO, Google Patents) ·
R, Python, Stata

## Research Experience

**Graduate Research Assistant** — Georgia Institute of Technology, School of Civil and
Environmental Engineering, Atlanta, GA<br>
*January 2023 – August 2023*

- Conducted academic and professional literature review on the implementation of emerging
  technologies in transportation infrastructure systems.
- Synthesized archival and interview research into logic models documenting the flow of
  O&M activities across different contractual vehicles.
- Assisted in structured interviews with contractual-risk subject-matter experts (state DOT
  officials, P3 contracting agencies, developers, utilities).

**Graduate Research Assistant** — University of Tokyo, Institute for Future Initiatives,
Tokyo, Japan<br>
*October 2020 – February 2022*

- Conducted bibliometric analysis of 500–1,000 scientific research papers on AI utilization
  in science using Stata.
- Co-designed and implemented a Qualtrics survey of AI researchers and domain scientists.
- Authored an analytical report on the policy implications of AI use in scientific research.

**Youngs Scholar Summer Researcher** — Denison University, Department of International
Studies, Granville, OH<br>
*May 2017 – February 2018*

- Conducted a case study on the political economy of Japanese popular culture and its role
  in Japan's soft power.
- Authored a research paper, "Political Economy of Japanese Popular Culture."
